observations.title: Read the modular debug HUD
observations.player_action: Open F3 and inspect its grouped information modules.
observations.outcome: Debug information appears in customizable modules instead of the vanilla arrangement.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Configure only the debug information needed
observations.player_action: Use F3 + M with Cloth Config, then move, color, hide or space modules and individual lines.
observations.outcome: The user controls module placement, visible data, text shadow, background and opening/closing animation.
conditions: The Forge settings shortcut requires Cloth Config; do not assume Fabric Mod Menu controls exist on Forge.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
